stage_type: contract-only preregistration for one future iterative development-validation transfer evaluation
scientific_question: Does the fully frozen R5-1A addition scorer with its fixed TRAIN-derived ROBUST_THETA transfer to the six unseen VALIDATION speakers without any validation calibration?

evidence_role.reason: The R4-4C2 acoustic checkpoint selected epoch 35 using PER on these VALIDATION speakers.
mitigating_facts: R5 addition labels did not select the R4 checkpoint
the R5-1A score formula was developed without VALIDATION
ROBUST_THETA was derived from TRAIN speaker-LOSO only
the metrics and gates in this contract are frozen before VALIDATION addition performance

frozen_model_and_scorer.model: R4-4C2 CNN plus one packed bidirectional GRU plus CTC
frozen_model_and_scorer.scorer_implementation: import and call the exact static-verified r5_1a_scorer.py; do not create another scorer implementation

hypotheses_and_score.insert: H_INSERT(E,b,p)=E[:b]+[p]+E[b:] for b in {0,...,N} and p in {0,...,39}
hypotheses_and_score.best_insert: maximum TARGET_SCORE among alignable INSERT candidates

alignability.adjacent_repeat_count: count of adjacent identical labels in H
alignability.keep_impossible_action: R5_1B_VALIDATION_BLOCKED_KEEP_ALIGNABILITY before performance interpretation; do not exclude the word
alignability.alignable_nonfinite_action: R5_1B_VALIDATION_TECHNICAL_FAILURE_NUMERICAL before performance interpretation; do not clip or repair

validation_population.population_rule: Apply the frozen R5-1A runtime-word reconstruction without validation-specific exclusions: unique manual-word containment, nonempty canonical expected sequence, no unresolved or malformed row in the word, and a reliable frozen MFA word span.

source_support_reference.role: R5-0 data-support information only; not a forced runtime-event count

validation_population.positive_word: eligible runtime word with at least one frozen clean addition event
validation_population.negative_word: eligible runtime word with zero frozen clean addition events
validation_population.correct_only_negative: zero additions, zero substitutions, zero deletions, and every eligible expected-phone relation correct
validation_population.substitution_negative: zero additions and at least one substitution; may overlap deletion-containing negative
validation_population.deletion_negative: zero additions and at least one deletion; may overlap substitution-containing negative
validation_population.row_accounting_failure_action: R5_1B_VALIDATION_BLOCKED_ROW_ACCOUNTING; preserve diagnostics and stop before performance interpretation

event_ground_truth.clean_addition: A frozen V4 row with tagged_relation=addition and resolved relation=addition, expected canonical placeholder <SIL>, observed phone in the frozen 40-phone vocabulary, ADDITION_AUDIT membership, and a finite positive-duration interval.
event_ground_truth.expected_sequence: canonical expected phones from clean resolved correct, substitution, and deletion rows in frozen source order; addition rows do not enter E
event_ground_truth.word_mapping: map an interval to its unique containing manual word; events without unique word containment remain source support but are not runtime word/event examples
event_ground_truth.boundary: number of eligible expected-sequence rows whose source_index precedes the addition source_index
event_ground_truth.position_ambiguous: retain in source-level support; exclude only from runtime position/exact-event metrics when unique word containment or nonempty expected sequence is unavailable
event_ground_truth.mixed_error_policy: retain eligible addition-positive words containing substitution and/or deletion and report their cohort flags
event_ground_truth.multiple_addition_policy: retain every clean event and the word; do not collapse multiple true events
event_ground_truth.non_runtime_evaluable_policy: report every event by frozen exclusion reason; do not silently discard or redefine it
event_ground_truth.predicted_event: one BEST_INSERT phone and expected-sequence boundary only when A>=ROBUST_THETA and best_insert_exists=true
event_ground_truth.exact_match: same word identity, canonical added phone, and expected-sequence insertion boundary
event_ground_truth.matching: deterministic one-to-one multiset matching using counter intersection on (word_id,boundary,phone_index)
event_ground_truth.multiple_addition_limitation: unmatched additional true events are false negatives

continuous_metrics.roc_auc: deterministic Mann-Whitney rank AUC with ascending exact comparisons and average ranks for exact ties; -infinity is the lowest ordered score and ties with -infinity

fixed_threshold_word_metrics.balanced_accuracy: mean of non-addition recall and addition recall
fixed_threshold_word_metrics.binary_macro_f1: mean of non-addition F1 and addition F1

interpretation_rule.strong_auc_but_failed_fixed_threshold: ranking evidence transferred but TRAIN-derived decision calibration did not transfer sufficiently

future_status_precedence: pre-metric technical status when scientifically valid metrics cannot be produced
R5_1B_VALIDATION_TRANSFER_PASS when all six scientific gates pass
R5_1B_VALIDATION_TRANSFER_NOT_CONFIRMED when any scientific gate fails

future_scientific_statuses.R5_1B_VALIDATION_TRANSFER_PASS: all six frozen transfer gates pass; iterative development transfer only
future_scientific_statuses.R5_1B_VALIDATION_TRANSFER_NOT_CONFIRMED: one or more frozen transfer gates fail; accept without retuning

test_policy.role: candidate independent final confirmation only after a transfer pass and a separately authorized dedicated locked TEST preregistration
test_policy.r5_1b_failure_action: do not open TEST; review the frozen failure first

forbidden_after_validation_access: alter ROBUST_THETA or choose a validation threshold
change TARGET normalization or add RAW/TIME variants
add insertion penalty, beam search, or language model
tune by speaker, phone, or boundary
remove mixed-error words or difficult speakers
change a gate or comparison operator
anti_drift.new_change_requires: a new named research generation with an appropriate independent evaluation design
